value.rationale: Natural exact profile-independent cutoff N=5 for the unmodified practical L-stable TR-BDF2 method on arbitrarily large complete multipartite networks; all off-diagonal transitions remain strictly positive despite all vertices eventually having a finite sign-loss interval in the diagonal. The full classification and exact two-zero mechanism distinguish graph-constrained positivity from the usual SSP radius and from other rational methods. No arbitrary parameter slice or cosmetic increment is required.
